post.summary:
The portal login (spec 0003, AC-11; spec 0007, AC-3): checks the password, builds the
launcher answer, then creates a web session and sets `welinc_sso`. Never answers a token.
No usable system means 403 and no session. A browser that already holds an SSO session
loses it first. An unverified email gets the code step instead, last of all, so nobody
without a system is sent a code (spec 0009, AC-7).

post.description: Called by a web app with its cookie. A request sent from this docs page is refused by the Origin check (403 `CSRF_REJECTED`), so try it from the portal instead.
post.summary:
Spec 0009, AC-9: the sign in step's code. The ticket's row, then the account and its systems
again (no try counted), then the code; a right one confirms the email and finishes the login
exactly as `/auth/login` does. 10 calls a minute per address (AC-6).

delete.summary:
Ends one of your sessions (`USER_ENDED`). Your current one too: the app then acts as after a
logout. A sid that isn't yours answers 404; one of yours that already ended answers 204.

post.summary:
Suite spec 0009, AC-11: the email step's code, in AC-9's order. The ticket's row, then the
client, the account and the grant again (no try counted), then the code; a right one confirms
the email and answers the token body. 10 calls a minute per address (AC-6).
Suite spec 0009, AC-11: a new code on the same ticket (AC-10).

info.title: WeLinc auth API
info.description:
The shared WeLinc auth service: sign in, sessions, tokens, people, roles and the permission matrix.

These docs are generated from the code and show the shapes of each route. On behavior (which
errors come when, lifetimes, the rules behind each route) the shared services contract wins:
[contract 0001](https://github.com/Capstone-WeLinc/welinc-workspace/blob/main/docs/specs/_root/0001-shared-services-contract/index.md).

userToken.description: A user access token (`token_use: user`), from the `/auth/token` code exchange or refresh.

serviceToken.description: A service token (`aud: AUTH`, with `scope`), from the `/auth/token` client credentials grant.

ssoCookie.name: welinc_sso
ssoCookie.description: welinc-auth's SSO cookie, set by `/auth/login` (`__Secure-welinc_sso` when hosted).

vrmsSession.name: vrms_rt
vrmsSession.description: The VRMS web session's refresh cookie, on `/vrms/session`.

clientAssertion.name: client_assertion
clientAssertion.description: A `private_key_jwt` client assertion, sent in the form body of `/auth/token` with `client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer` (OpenAPI has no form body scheme, so it is listed here as a named field).

attachExisting.description: Add the roles to the account that already owns this email (spec 0011, AC-30).

reauthToken.description: Spec 0013, AC-14a, AC-14b: the actor's ADMIN_ACTION reauth token, when the change needs it.
Spec 0013, AC-14a, AC-14b: the actor's ADMIN_ACTION reauth token, when the change needs it.

message.description: A sentence for people; may change. Match on `code`, never on this.

code.description: The stable error code (contract 0001 section 11). Absent on a plain validation 400.

attachExisting.description: Add the roles to the account that already owns this email (spec 0011, AC-30).

reauthToken.description: Spec 0013, AC-14a, AC-14b: the actor's ADMIN_ACTION reauth token, when the change needs it.

next.description: Where to read from next; never null

missing.description: Ids the caller's system never held, as sent

next.description: The next page cursor; null on the last page

changesCursor.description: Where to start reading `/auth/directory/changes` after this scan

phone.description: Only with the `directory.contact` scope; null otherwise

temporaryRoles.description: The part of `roles` that comes from a temporary grant

reauthToken.description: Spec 0013, AC-14b: an admin sending a code to an admin account sends their reauth token.

systems.description: The web systems the person can open, in launcher order

recaptchaToken.description: Sent by the portal once reCAPTCHA (WL-103) is wired; not checked yet.

lockedAt.description: Set only while a lock is active (ISO 8601)

pendingEmail.description: The new address of a pending email change

clientId.description: A public native client, such as `vmms-mobile`.

deviceName.description: The device as the app reports it; trimmed and cut to 100 characters (AC-33).

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

sessionExpiresAt.description: When the session ends if idle (ISO 8601)

error_description.example: The code is invalid or used

lockedRoles.description: Roles whose cell for this key can never change

kid.description: The key id a token header names

expiresAt.description: The earlier of the idle and the absolute end (ISO 8601)

challengeId.description: Send it back with the code

resendAfter.description: Seconds before a new code can be asked for

version.description: Raised on every change; also the ETag

grants.description: Role code to the permission keys it holds; every role has an entry

webAddress.description: The system's web app address; null when it has none

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires

scope.description: `client_credentials` only: the granted scopes, space separated

sid.description: User grants only: the session id

session_expires_at.description: User grants only: when the session ends if idle (ISO 8601)

session_absolute_expires_at.description: User grants on a web session only: the hard end of the session (ISO 8601)

reauthToken.description: Spec 0013, AC-14a, AC-14b: the actor's ADMIN_ACTION reauth token, when the change needs it.
